Video 12: Foot Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Pedis (Latin for foot) & Podos (Greek for foot)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: pedal, pedestrian, biped, podiatrist, tripod
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on TurtleDiary
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write a story about a pedestrian who finds a camera tripod on the sidewalk.
Video 13: Word Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Verbum (Latin for word) & Logos (Greek for word)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: verb, verbose, verbatim, logic, analogy, apology
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on ABCya!
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write an apology note to a friend. Try to use at least one other vocabulary word.
Video 14: Light Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Lux, Lucere (Latin for light) & Phos, Photos (Greek for light)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: lucid, translucent, elucidate, photograph, photosynthesis
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on RoomRecess
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Imagine you are a plant. Describe how you use photosynthesis to grow.
Video 15: Life Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Vita (Latin for life) & Bios (Greek for life)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: vitamin, vitality, vital, biology, biography, autobiography
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on TurtleDiary
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write a short autobiography about your life so far. What gives you vitality?
Day 1: Earth Words – Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Terra (Latin for earth) & Geo (Greek for earth)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: territory, terrace, subterranean, geology, geography, geometry
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on RoomRecess
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Pretend you are an explorer. Write a journal entry about the geography of a new territory you discovered.
Day 1: Writing Words – Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Scribo (Latin for write) & Grapho (Greek for write)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: scribble, scribe, inscribe, autograph, photograph, biography
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on TurtleDiary
Day 4: Writing Assignment - Write a short biography of your favorite superhero and ask for their autograph.
Video 16: Man Words – Day 1: Watch Word Up! Video - Focus: Vir, Homo (Latin for man) & Anthropos, Andros (Greek for man)
Day 2: Review & Write - Vocabulary Words: virile, virtue, homicide, anthropology, android
Day 3: Game Day! - Play a game on ABCya!
Day 4: Writing Assignment - If you could build an android, what would it do? What virtue would be most important for it to have?
